E4Plus1.uk.description: Million Dollar Maybe: Homer wins the lottery jackpot but has to keep it secret from the family. Guest starring Chris Martin from Coldplay. (S21 Ep11/23)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: Bachelor/ette Party: Boyle organises an elaborate scavenger hunt for Peralta's bachelor party, but the guys take short cuts that throw the event into disarray. (S5 Ep19)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: Show Me Going: The squad worry about Diaz when she responds to an active shooter alert. (S5 Ep20)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Arrested: Haley gets arrested for underage drinking, so Phil, Claire - and their lawyer - head to the police station. Cameron looks after Alex and Luke, who get into crazy mishaps. (S4 Ep7)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Mistery Date: When Claire takes Manny and Luke along to Alex's academic decathlon for the weekend, Phil attempts to throw together a boys' night at the house. (S4 Ep8)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: When a Tree Falls: Mitch helps Cam to save an old tree in the park, while Jay and Manny go beyond their comfort zones at a kid's Olympics-themed birthday party. (S4 Ep9)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Diamond in the Rough: When Manny and Luke's little league team unexpectedly makes it into a playoff game, Claire and Cameron scramble to find a location for it. (S4 Ep10)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Sex, Pies and Idiot Scrapes: Homer and Flanders become bounty hunters. Marge gets a job at an erotic bakery. (S20 Ep1/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Lost Verizon: When Bart finds Denis Leary's phone and uses it to make prank calls and accept job offers, Denis comes up with a creative punishment for him. (S20 Ep2/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Double, Double, Boy in Trouble: Bart switches places with his doppelganger Simon. But it turns out Simon's wealthy family are plotting against him. (S20 Ep3/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Take My Life, Please: Homer is annoyed when his old high school nemesis Vance Connor gets a spot on the Springfield Walk of Fame. (S20 Ep10/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Gal of Constant Sorrow: Bart and Lisa get to know a homeless folk singer. Homer's attempt at DIY traps the cat in the walls of the house, so he launches a rescue bid. (S27 Ep14/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Lisa the Veterinarian: Lisa is inspired to become a vet and begins an internship at a local surgery. Marge gets a job as a crime scene cleaner but finds it traumatic. (S27 Ep15/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Below Deck Down Under
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: Johnny and a guest send the deck team into a frenzied panic when they flip a jet ski in dangerously shallow water. (S3 Ep5)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox: Celebrity Special...
E4Plus1.uk.description: ...for SU2C: Tom Daley, Charlotte Church and Gordon Ramsay join regular Goggleboxers for a special edition including The Watcher, I Can See Your Voice and Love Is Blind. (S20 Ep8)

E4Plus1.uk.title: American Pie 2
E4Plus1.uk.description: (2001) Crude, still-coming-of-age comedy with Jason Biggs and Eugene Levy. The lads' shenanigans continue as they return from college to do it - or not - all over again.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Naked Attraction
E4Plus1.uk.description: Zoe is struggling to find someone who shares her enthusiasm for the natural look. Derry is worried that his jet-set lifestyle is ruining his chances of finding love. (S4 Ep2)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox: Celebrity Special...
E4Plus1.uk.description: ...for SU2C: Tom Daley, Charlotte Church and Gordon Ramsay join regular Goggleboxers for a special edition including The Watcher, I Can See Your Voice and Love Is Blind. (S20 Ep8)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Below Deck Down Under
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: Johnny and a guest send the deck team into a frenzied panic when they flip a jet ski in dangerously shallow water. (S3 Ep5)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Abbott Elementary
E4Plus1.uk.description: Franklin Institute: On the school trip to the Franklin Institute, Ava causes chaos when she decides to teach the children about aliens. (S2 Ep22) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Circle of Driving Again: When Murray insists that Adam must have driving lessons, the family learn something new about Pops. Barry visits Erica at college. (S5 Ep8)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4Plus1.uk.description: Parents Just Don't Understand: Adam and Barry write a song but don't get the reaction they were expecting from Murray. Beverly repeatedly calls Erica at college. (S5 Ep9)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: Chasing Amy: Santiago vanishes hours before her sergeant's exam. Can Peralta and Diaz find her and bring her back before it's too late? (S4 Ep18)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: Your Honor: Captain Holt's mother seeks help from the precinct. Jeffords, Diaz and Boyle redecorate the breakroom. Santiago teaches Gina how to change a tyre. (S4 Ep19)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Casa Roma: Gordon visits Casa Roma, the oldest restaurant in Lancaster, California. Although the bar is a success, the restaurant is failing and has had 20 chefs in two years. (S2 Ep8) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Great Australian Bake Off
E4Plus1.uk.description: Italian Week: Our bakers serve up a slice of la dolce vita with pizzas, pesche con crema and tiramisu centrepieces. Who'll be saying arrivederci to the shed? (S7 Ep8/10)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Gordon Returns: Gordon Ramsay revisits some of the restaurants he set out to save, including The Mixing Bowl, The Olde Stone Mill, Peter's and Campania. Have things improved? (S2 Ep13)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Hotel Hell
E4Plus1.uk.description: Angler's Lodge: Gordon Ramsay visits Angler's Lodge in Idaho, a stunning venue whose owners have been struck by family tragedy. Can he rescue the broken business? (S3 Ep1)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Hotel Hell
E4Plus1.uk.description: Vienna Inn: Gordon checks in to the Vienna Inn, an Austrian-themed hotel and restaurant in Massachusetts, where business isn't what it used to be. Can he keep their doors open? (S3 Ep2)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Spies in Disguise
E4Plus1.uk.description: (2019) Animated spy comedy caper with the voice of Will Smith. The 'world's most awesome spy' gets framed and has to go undercover as a pigeon to prove his innocence.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Cheaper by the Dozen
E4Plus1.uk.description: (2003) Family comedy. Steve Martin and Bonnie Hunt star as parents to 12 children. Things go well until their careers take off, when their chaotic lives start to spiral out of control.

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Full Heart, Empty Pool: Grampa and Homer accidentally invent a new sport while arguing in a drained pool. But trouble arrives when Big Avocado sponsors it. (S36 Ep17)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Estranger Things: When Bart and Lisa lose interest in their only shared love, Marge worries they'll drift apart as they grow up. Cue a glimpse into the future. (S36 Ep18)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Beyond Blunderdome: Mel Gibson hires Homer to help him rewrite his remake of Mr Smith Goes to Washington. (S11 Ep1/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brother's Little Helper: An experimental ADHD drug improves Bart's behaviour but makes him paranoid: is Major League Baseball using a satellite to read his thoughts? (S11 Ep2/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Barthood: Bart's coming-of-age story is told, chronicling his life from youth to adulthood. But his tense relationship with Homer and being overshadowed by Lisa shape him. (S27 Ep9/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Girl Code: Marge posts a photo on social media that gets Homer fired, so he returns to his old job as a dish-washer in a Greek restaurant. Lisa creates an app. (S27 Ep10/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Teenage Mutant Milk-Caused Hurdles: Bart is smitten with his new teacher and tries to impress her. Homer buys a new type of milk that has a strange effect on Bart and Lisa. (S27 Ep11/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Much Apu About Something: Apu loses his job when his shop is rebranded as a health food market aimed at a hip young crowd. Bart's latest prank has terrible consequences. (S27 Ep12/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Love Is in the N2-O2-Ar-CO2-Ne-He-CH4: Professor Frink uses science to turn into a ladies' man. And medication makes Grampa and the Retirement Castle residents hallucinate. (S27 Ep13/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Battleship
E4Plus1.uk.description: (2012) Sci-fi action-adventure starring Taylor Kitsch, Liam Neeson and Rihanna. When aliens land spacecraft in the Pacific Ocean, only the US and Japanese navies can save Earth.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Celebrity Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: This time, the celebs watch Love Island, Who Wants to Be a Millionaire?, Celebrity Bridge of Lies, Bake Off: The Professionals, Ladies First and This Morning (strippers). (S8 Ep2)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: A look back at the best of Series 27. What did the Goggleboxers make of the finest and funniest TV from home and abroad? (S27 Ep17)
